sources.snippet: SAM3 ONNX (fp16) fp16 ONNX export of Meta's SAM 3 (image model, ViT-H) for ONNX Runtime. It's the model set behind Sam3.Net, which downloads these files automatically. Runs on CUDA, DirectML (any vendor), CoreML and CPU. Peak GPU use is about 7 GB.
